items.statement: Within the stated computational model, the reported retained-K calculation gives a Pr4+/Pr3+ potential close to the experimental anodic boundary and therefore supports the retained-counterion interpretation as a model-consistent explanation.
items.expected: The conclusion states quantitative agreement in the appropriate direction and explicitly limits the inference to the molecular/implicit-THF model.

items.statement: Agreement with an experimental irreversible wave does not establish a unique microscopic pathway and is sensitive to solvation, thermal and electronic-structure assumptions.
items.expected: The report acknowledges model sensitivity and does not claim to reproduce the full voltammogram or prove a unique mechanism.
